# daily-research

> An autonomous research feedback engine that runs inside the operator's research repositories. Every morning at 05:00, macOS launchd runs Claude Code (`claude -p`) once per research line with the line's repo as the working directory — four lines mapped 1:1 to DOI-registered repos: `akc` (agent-knowledge-cycle), `contemplative` (contemplative-agent), `aap` (agent-attribution-practice), `authorship` (authorship-strategy). Each run reads the repo's own operational context (CLAUDE.md, task ledger, open questions) and writes an actionable-tactics note to an Obsidian vault; at 07:00 a deterministic morning brief sends the day's proposed moves to Slack for approval. Single Sonnet pass per line (the earlier central 2-pass Opus+Sonnet pipeline was retired by ADR-0008). Bash orchestration with prompt files; JSON/TOML parsing in stdlib python3 (no pip dependencies, no orchestration framework).

## Architecture

- [ADR-0008](docs/adr/0008-per-repo-in-context-research.md): per-repo in-context research — the current architecture; retires the concept-graph-driven theme selection
- [ADR-0006](docs/adr/0006-self-improvement-loop-human-consumer.md): self-improvement loop (report gate, deterministic lint, metrics, /dr-review) — preserved under ADR-0008
- [ADR-0007](docs/adr/0007-return-to-four-repo-concept-reinforcement.md): four 1:1 repo lines (line structure inherited by ADR-0008)
- [ADR-0001](docs/adr/0001-research-repo-feedback-engine.md): why tracks map to research repositories (historical origin)
- [Per-repo research protocol](prompts/repo-research-protocol.md): the run's objective function, diff-first pass, citation gate, premise-challenge pass
- [Report template](templates/report-template.md): actionable-tactics note format (lead section: 今すぐ実行可能な手 with expiry conditions)
- [Main entry point](scripts/daily-research.sh): per-line orchestration, retry, report gate, lint, metrics
- [Morning brief](scripts/morning-brief.sh): 07:00 deterministic extraction and Slack approval request (no LLM)
